method.phases: Differences between captured NTFS last-write times of immutable helper records, relative to invocation.started_at; final boundary is session elapsed time. Approximate wall intervals, not CPU attribution. Metadata is captured here because Git blobs do not retain it.
method.tools: Claude assistant tool_use timestamp to matching user tool_result timestamp; union of intervals avoids double counting. Only tool names, line numbers and timestamps are exported.
method.limits: Outside-tool time includes provider generation/waits, compaction, startup and other host activity. It is not measured reasoning time. Helper subprocess totals are a subset and may overlap. Codex lacks comparable tool-event timestamps. No local-versus-hosted matched baseline exists.

phases.phase: Validation, approval, start and initial reads
